name: irodori-tts-watermark-detector
description: Browser/WebAssembly detector for the SilentCipher watermark embedded by Irodori-TTS

scripts.samples: python tools/make_samples.py --variant 44.1k && python tools/make_samples.py --variant 16k && python tools/make_samples.py --variant 44.1k --payload HELLO --slug-suffix _hello --seconds 10
scripts.test: node --test test/dsp.test.mjs test/parity.test.mjs test/variants.test.mjs test/payload.test.mjs test/e2e.test.mjs
